text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just when we thought the issue with concentration was handled, a new problem of "overworking" came to light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, Espoir City refused to skip
either her voluntary training
or her regular sessions.
choice_data_list: (...If this keeps up, I'll hit my limit eventually.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)
choice_data_list: Hm? A phone call...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the smartphone lying on the desk.
The name displayed on the screen is...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
Happy New Year~.
Sorry for dropping by so unexpectedly.
choice_data_list: No, no, please, right this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person who called yesterday
was none other than her mother.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Once you're done with your greetings,
hurry up and go home."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know.
Staying too long would only be a bother
to your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Just for a little bit, though, please?
After all, a mother wants to hear from the Trainer about how hard her daughter is working every day.”

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"So... Trainer.
How does Espoir look to you—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Suuuuuper insanely strooong!!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Espo.
I was asking your Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She glares at me intently.
Her eyes saying, "Don't say anything unnecessary."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, her mother was the one she wanted
most to acknowledge that "she is strong."
In that case, I need to choose my words carefully...
choice_data_list: She shows her competitive spirit every single day.
I'm making sure to take proper breaks too! ...Right?
I'm making sure to take proper breaks too! ...Right?
I'm currently honing my technique.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, her mother was the one she wanted
most to acknowledge that "she is strong."
In that case, I need to choose my words carefully...
choice_data_list: She shows her competitive spirit every single day.
I'm making sure to take proper breaks too! ...Right?
I'm making sure to take proper breaks too! ...Right?
I'm currently honing my technique.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!
choice_data_list: That's your weapon, but it's also a double-edged sword...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She glares at me with tremendous intensity.
...But I can't back down here either.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“...... I see.
Thank you for letting me know.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Get home safe! ...Don't catch a cold, alright?!
...And send me a 'LANE' message when you get home!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So annoying.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... aren't you impressive, Espo!
Your schedule management is flawless too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Because she's a capable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Get home safe! ...Don't catch a cold, alright?!
...And send me a 'LANE' message when you get home!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's it! Mom doesn't have a single thing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"My, my!
That just means your Trainer sees
a lo~t of potential in you, doesn't it?♪"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Get home safe! ...Don't catch a cold, alright?!
...And send me a 'LANE' message when you get home!!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Sorry for worrying you.
And thank you very much, Trainer~.
choice_data_list: Please stay well, and take good care!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading home too.
choice_data_list: Um, Espo—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: See ya!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She slipped away from me again.
At this rate, it'll just be a repeat of last year.
choice_data_list: I have to properly face her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone tucked away in the pocket vibrates repeatedly as if demanding attention.
Even though this is hardly the time for it—
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for calling you out here, Trainer.
...I really needed to talk to you one-on-one.
choice_data_list: No... so, what was it you wanted to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person I had just met a moment ago
took a breath before beginning to speak.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“...... What I am about to tell you,
please keep it a secret from my daughter.”

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Hasn't her bravado
been growing stronger by the day?"
choice_data_list: ...! Why that—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Because the way she used to be was the complete opposite of who she is now."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...She was such a crybaby, easily scared.
Always hiding behind my back.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Even when we visited the training club where her father works, she wouldn't leave my side. That was just the kind of child she was.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Still.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day... when my health failed and I was hospitalized—

text_block_list.name: Espoir of the Past
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mom, I got almost a perfect score on my test!
And... the teacher asked me to be
a PE committee member too!’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir of the Past
text_block_list.text: "I can do tons of stuff! I'm super amazing, y'know! So, like—"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...She started boasting to me about all kinds of things while I was in the hospital room."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And she proudly told me she had
"prepared lots of stories" for when I got back, and then...—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fighting back tears that were about to spill
from her large eyes... she encourages me.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: I told you, there's no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if unpleasant things happen,
even if sad things occur.
...Even if you fall into painful circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... totally fine!
So don't worry about me!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Cuz I'm tough!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a brave front, as if to hide
the immense anxiety weighing on her.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...I understand because I'm a mother.
And that is precisely why... I couldn't just brush it aside.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"All that bravado of hers is—
...just a cover for her anxiety."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Even though it was all inside out.
choice_data_list: Everything's inside out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case,
it changes the way I see her.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ordinary training just ain't gonna cut it!
I gotta do at least as much as running with Tap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Even those words and actions that seemed to stem from her competitive spirit."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't the guys in the stands
think I was way stronger than the rest, too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's constantly distracted by everything around her... that lack of focus, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she's thinking,
"This isn't enough for someone as strong as me,"
or "I want to show off how strong I am."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What if the reason was...
'Thinking she lacked training because she was weak,'
or 'Fearing that she would be judged as weak'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "What didn't you like about my training?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "What didn't you like about my training?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: If I had a problem with it, I wouldn't bother coming every time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason she added extra solo training, and the reason she craved training from me, her Trainer—everything aligns.
choice_data_list: Because I think of myself as weak.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
please look after that girl."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that bravado, several paths
have closed off to her.
Including the whole matter with her father."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“After meeting you, though...
and finishing her debut race, that girl—”

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...She was laughing on the other end of the line.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer said that
"you'll definitely become stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To keep entering more and more races...
That was the promise they made together.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
She was smiling with pure pride from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please, make that child strong.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Not the bravado I put on for myself
just to hide my anxiety and cowardice—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Please grant that child true strength.
choice_data_list: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the coffee shop,
I escort Espoir City's mother
back to the station once again.
choice_data_list: ...I'll definitely figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened my "textbook" for Espoir City.
...To explore what I could do for her as her Trainer.
